population: Every fixture in each of the 20 scope entries, original R5 date bands for development/primary/recent. Primary and recent are already opened research replays.
new_early_test: European domestic data collected independently: development 2014-07-01 through 2016-06-30; first unseen evaluation 2016-07-01 through 2017-06-30. For calendar data if collected: development calendar 2016 and first unseen evaluation calendar 2017. Train only before development; include only verified disjoint matches. No selection on any evaluation.
locked_primary: conditional: goal distribution anchored in observed markets, carried within-competition team strength across stages, prior team process from regulation shots/on-target/xG when available. Use a single league-specific penalized multinomial residual on score cells. One sorted distribution supplies all 3 scores. Where an actual market directional comparator exists, follow that side. Otherwise pick from the model. No confident-only filtering.
fixed_recipe: 25x25 score support retained; 75% competition-wide and 25% phase-local goal rates blended geometrically; prior process proxies xG then smoothed shots-on-target and total shots; same calendar-day embargo. Regularized exponential tilt: four low-score cells, 4+ and 6+ totals, draw, signed favourite margin interaction, home/away goal-rate discrepancies and total discrepancy from lagged attack/defence; absolute coefficient bounds .65, Gaussian penalty 50 on sum negative log probability. Half lives inherited from R5. No per-league sweep, no head selection. Apply both independent market marginals only if separately identified. Evaluation labels withheld from fit; weights refreshed once on all prior matches only for future study.
comparators: archived R5 final learned-head forecast where available
cross-stage structural anchor without residual or process
diagnostics: market implied expected Top1/Top3/WDL/full-win on complete book
1-1 forecast counts with realized counts conditional on that choice
prior match counts within stage and across competition
market and process data coverage, impossible full wins at quarter-line boundaries
metrics: actual Asian full wins / non-push observed actual line >= .70
inference: Same fixtures per comparison, date-cluster paired 95% intervals, missing lines retained in coverage, completed regulation only. Archived price categories without source clocks are historical proxies.
forward: Issue an additional research track for the complete previously registered 192-match slate while still prematch. Pair with R5 corrected research freeze and its independent market-priority track. Current/Test/Primary promotion requires separate authorization.
